jobs.title: Public Area Attendant

Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. Connect with Bahamian beauty in an enclave of remarkable seclusion, where intimate low-rise buildings are immersed in 14 hectares (35 acres) of Versailles-inspired lawns and gardens. Wake up to breakfast on your private balcony, then indulge in a restorative treatment in one of our Balinese-style spa villas or head out for a round of golf at Ocean Club Golf Course. When Legends Come To Life Since opening in 1962, The Ocean Club has welcomed the worldâs most discerning guests to our five-mile stretch of natural white sand beach â framed by 35 acres of Versailles inspired lawns and gardens. On a stretch of natural white sand beach, our resort offers 107 ultra-luxury accommodations, a Balinese-inspired spa, and dining by Michelin-starred chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten. The Ocean Club has a treasured history serving generations of luxury travelers. Expansive lawns and towering coconut palms provide an enchanting backdrop to the pristine beaches of Paradise Island. The Ocean Club offers a rich roster of activities including water sports such as snorkeling, sailing and wind-surfing along with land-based activities including world-class golf and tennis plus a relaxing spa. jobs.title: Irrigation Technician

jobs.description: About This Role Enjoy a variety of field work and office-based work Ongoing, Full Time Opportunity in Bendigo Salary Range $72,189 - $79,753 plus superannuation Do you have great communication skills and want to be a role model to people hoping for a second chance? If you want to make time to help people get their lives back on track, read on. Who are we? Community Work and Partnerships We are responsible for the development of mutually beneficial partnerships with government agencies and non-government organisations so that individuals can undertake unpaid work as part of their community-based sentence imposed by the Courts of Victoria. Community work serves as a valuable way for individuals to pay back the community while also reconnecting and reintegrating into the community. We ensure individuals make genuine efforts to undergo rehabilitation, and we keep low risk individuals out of prison and help them contribute to the community. What does a Field Officer do? Your primary responsibility as a Field Officer will be to supervise a team of clients at community work sites and other community work programs. A field officer carries out many duties and functions, mainly the supervision of individuals completing community work tasks. Other responsibilities include performing site inspections, assess hazards, providing informed workplace health and safety advice, guidance and instruction; maintaining tools and equipment resister and ensuring repairs are undertaken. A day in the life of a Field Officer. . . Your shift starts at a Justice Service Centre location where you collect a bus/ trailer with equipment. You then drive to a site to collect a group of clients, where you will induct, instruct and transport them to a partner not-for-profit organisation in the community. Tasks for the day may involve graffiti removal, painting, litter collection, mowing and weeding. Your responsibility is to instruct the individuals to safely perform each task and monitor the work performed for the partner site before returning them to the drop off point and returning to your depot. We are looking for individuals with various backgrounds and experience. Some desirable skills include: You'll need to be able to communicate and demonstrate a range of tasks and ensure a safe environment for work teams. Quickly build rapport in order to understand the motivations of others, identify issues and suggest courses of action appropriate to their needs. Have demonstrated ability to manage conflict and strong problem-solving skills. Model appropriate behaviours and attitudes to assist individuals to develop new skills and work practices. Carpentry or handyman skills Gardening landscaping or painting skills Field Officers carry out a mixture of field work and office-based work, so it's important that you are able to demonstrate computer skills and written communication skills. Transporting individuals is also a key part of the role and Field Officers will be required to drive a 12-seater bus with trailer. A full and current drivers' licence is essential for this position. Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading. About This Role: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio. We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding. Our Benefits: At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect: A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities. A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge. A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life. Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role. Mental health coaching to support your well-being. Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections. The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company. A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are. *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. Responsibilities: In this role, you will: Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience. Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance. Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis. Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension. Drive & Ownership: Du ergreifst die Initiative, übernimmst Verantwortung und bleibst auch dann dran, wenn es herausfordernd wird. Wenn dir etwas wichtig ist, gehst du die Extrameile. Communication: Du trittst selbstbewusst auf, kannst Menschen für dich gewinnen und hast keine Scheu davor, Entscheider direkt anzusprechen – auch telefonisch im Cold Calling. Growth Mindset: Du willst schnell besser werden, suchst aktiv Feedback und setzt Learnings direkt in bessere Ergebnisse um. Languages: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau und verhandlungssicheres Englisch. jobs.title: Brand Experience Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About Yepoda Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations, from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients. Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe – online and in over 250 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day. As Brand Experience Manager , you will own the end-to-end customer and brand experience across all touchpoints, online and offline. Your focus is to map and elevate the customer journey, shape unboxing and product experience, and turn customer insight into segmentation and decisions that keep Yepoda consistent, desirable, and loved at every interaction. Your Tasks Own the end-to-end customer journey across channels, identifying and resolving friction points through data, surveys, and feedback Partner with Marketing, Website, and CRM to personalize digital experiences at scale Lead the unboxing and product experience — packaging, inserts, merchandise — partnering with Creative and Product Development on new launches, artwork approvals, and regulatory compliance across markets Build data-driven customer segmentation and personas with CRM and Data teams to power tailored journeys Own Voice of Customer efforts (reviews, surveys, social listening, support) and the brand perception/awareness studies, turning insights into dashboards and recommendations Track CX and brand health KPIs (NPS, repurchase rate, churn, Brand Health Index) Guard brand consistency across tone, visuals, and copy; own the Brand Book and ensure correct use of sustainability certifications (B Corp, 1% for the Planet) Mentor junior team members on tools, processes, and onboarding Manage cross-functional brand projects (e.g. Advent Calendar, Holiday Boxes, Sephora editions) from concept to launch Your Profile Several years of experience in CX, brand marketing, or customer insights, ideally within beauty, lifestyle, or consumer brands. Proven ability to translate data and customer feedback into actionable strategy and measurable outcomes. Experience managing cross-functional projects across marketing, product, creative, and operations. Comfortable owning segmentation, journey mapping, and CX reporting end-to-end. Some experience coaching or mentoring junior team members. Highly organised, analytical, and detail-oriented, with strong project management skills across parallel workstreams. Collaborative, calm, and adaptable in a fast-moving scale-up environment. Fluent in English; additional European languages (e.g. German, French, Spanish, or Italian) are a plus. Experience working closely with packaging design and production teams is a strong plus. What We Offer Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team. Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand. Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks. Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery. We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default. Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going! Unique add-o

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 70 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world. What You'll Do 🎯 Own front desk and guest relations, serving as the first point of contact for candidates, guests, and employees while ensuring a professional, welcoming experience. Own candidate coordination and end-to-end onsite interviews, scheduling and confirming panels and rooms, and hosting candidates on the day so every interview feels considered and well-run. Manage guest check-in and hospitality (visitor system, tours, refreshments), protecting confidentiality and accessibility needs. Provide light scheduling and calendar support to the leadership team, growing into broader responsibilities over time. Take on ad hoc projects, event support, and admin tasks as they come up, with this part of the role growing gradually as you settle in. Keep meeting-room calendars organised and up to date, and close the loop on requests with clear ETAs. Mail, packages, and facilities requests sit separately with our workplace team, so this role can stay focused on people, not logistics. What You'll Bring 💡 Experience in coordination, team assistance, front of house, hospitality, or similar admin support, with a hospitality-first mindset and interest in growing into a wider administrative support role. Ownership mentality, seeing things through once something is picked up and closing every loop rather than leaving it half-finished. Bringing questions, ideas, and solutions rather than just problems. Precise as well as fast, with small details like names, times, rooms, and confirmations never slipping. Strong prioritisation across competing demands, candidate needs, leadership's asks, and office operations, with a clear sense of what to put down first when they collide. Comfort with Google Workspace, Slack, and calendar scheduling, with a quick ability to pick up new tools like visitor systems, ATS, and Notion independently. Using AI tools to draft, summarise, and stay organised is a plus. Clear, professional communication with candidates, employees, leaders, and external partners, along with discretion handling sensitive information. Genuine comfort with ambiguity and fast-changing priorities, likely built in an environment that moved quickly and reshuffled plans at short notice, coming out of it composed rather than rattled. What Makes You a Great Fit You've worked in environments that move quickly and change plans often. You keep calm when priorities shift or several things land at once. You can absorb a shifted priority or a last-minute change without losing momentum. You move quickly, set clear expectations, and follow through until resolution. You take initiative to streamline scheduling or check-in, and you want a role that grows with you. Why Almedia? 🚀 Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success. Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one. Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin. Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more. We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. Teams who train together, stay together: We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead. It takes a team to Tandem: Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights. Balance matters: Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax. Modern family: As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem. Relocation without the stress: If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time. Hybrid by design: We’re all about embracing a flexible, modern way of working. jobs.title: Senior Software Entwickler / Tech Lead – Java, Spring & Jakarta EE*
jobs.description: Was dich erwartet Fullstack-Entwicklung: Du entwickelst anspruchsvolle Java- und Webanwendungen im Front- und Backend – sowohl in modernen Spring-Umgebungen als auch im Jakarta EE Umfeld. Dabei bringst du deine Erfahrung aktiv in Kundenprojekte ein und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden passende, nachhaltige Lösungen. Brückenbauer zwischen alter und neuer Java-Welt: Du kennst sowohl gewachsene Enterprise-Anwendungslandschaften und klassische Jakarta EE Architekturen als auch moderne Spring-, Cloud- und Microservice-Architekturen. Du verstehst die Stärken und Herausforderungen beider Welten und kannst bestehende Anwendungen und Architekturen schrittweise in moderne, zukunftsfähige Lösungen überführen. Architektur & Modernisierung: Du denkst nicht nur in Technologien, sondern in nachhaltigen Architekturen. Du analysierst bestehende Systeme, erkennst Modernisierungspotenziale und entwickelst Strategien, wie sich gewachsene Anwendungen sinnvoll weiterentwickeln lassen – ohne dabei funktionierende Lösungen unnötig über Bord zu werfen. Qualität & Engineering: Clean Code, Test Driven Development und DevOps gehören für dich zum professionellen Software Engineering und sind fester Bestandteil deiner täglichen Arbeit. Technologie & Innovation: Du interessierst dich für aktuelle Technologien, Architekturen und Trends und bewertest deren sinnvollen Einsatz. Gleichzeitig weißt du, dass moderne Softwareentwicklung im Enterprise-Umfeld häufig auf bestehenden Systemen aufbaut und nicht jede Lösung bei null beginnt. Problemlösung: Du analysierst komplexe technische Herausforderungen, optimierst bestehende Lösungen und findest pragmatische Wege, Legacy-Systeme mit modernen Technologien zu verbinden. Kollaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit Kollegen und anderen Teams zusammen und bringst dein technisches Know-how aktiv ein, um gemeinsam die bestmögliche Lösung für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln. Beraterrolle: Du bist nicht nur Entwickler, sondern auch technischer Berater. Du verstehst die Anforderungen unserer Kunden, hinterfragst bestehende Ansätze und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre Anwendungen und Architekturen nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln. Weiterentwicklung: Du hast die Möglichkeit, dich durch praxisorientierte Trainings – insbesondere in Softwarearchitektur, Modernisierung und Cloud-Technologien – sowie durch den regelmäßigen Erfahrungsaustausch in unseren Gilden fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Was du mitbringst Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Fullstack-Entwicklung und hast einen starken Backend-Schwerpunkt in Java, gern ergänzt durch Kotlin oder Python. Du verfügst über tiefgreifende Kenntnisse in der modernen Java-Entwicklung mit Spring, insbesondere Spring Boot und Spring Cloud. Gleichzeitig bringst du fundierte Erfahrung mit Jakarta EE und klassischen Enterprise-Anwendungslandschaften mit und kennst Application Server wie JBoss oder WebSphere. Du verstehst die Unterschiede und Zusammenhänge zwischen klassischen und modernen Java-Architekturen und hast idealerweise bereits Anwendungen oder Systeme modernisiert bzw. bei der Migration auf neue Architekturen begleitet. Du hast regelmäßig Entwicklungsanteile im Frontend übernommen und bringst bestenfalls Erfahrung mit React oder Angular sowie JSF oder PrimeFaces mit. Du bringst Erfahrung mit CI/CD-Pipelines, Containerisierung und Cloud-Diensten mit. Du kannst dich sowohl in bestehende, komplexe Systemlandschaften einarbeiten als auch neue technische Lösungen konzipieren und umsetzen. Deine hohe Selbstorganisation, dein Teamgeist und deine ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz zeichnen dich aus. Bestenfalls bringst du bereits Erfahrung in der (Teil-)Projektleitung mit. Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch. ​ Worauf du dich freuen kannst - unsere Benefits Innovative Projekte und kreatives Umfeld: Du arbeitest an spannenden Projekten in einem kreativen und dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Raum für eigene Idee

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect - Enterprise
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><h3><strong>What Is The Role</strong></h3> <p>Are you looking to make a real impact and play a meaningful role in the growth of our company?</p> <p>As a Solutions Architect at Elastic you will serve as a technical authority and trusted advisor to our sales team, customers, partners and community. You will understand and solve our customer’s business issues with the Elastic Stack, engage the regional Elastic community through events and programs, and enable sales through our Partners. A successful SA at Elastic will be focused on excellence; taking the initiative to improve both themselves and the team through continuous learning and questioning the status quo.</p> <p>Why Elastic and this Team? “Once I started, I was blown away to realize, what was always so obvious, everything is search. Anything you do with data involves search, every app needs search, even analytics are about search. Daily I am blown away with the types of things our users and customers are doing with search.” <em>Director of Product, Elastic. </em>“We question the status quo, debate the best ways to accomplish our goals and hold ourselves and our teams to the highest standards of performance. We take pride in our ability to understand our customers needs and make recommendations that are based on extensive global experience across multiple use cases. We learn from our mistakes and losses and celebrate our successes with an eye towards constant improvement. Join this team if you are up for a compassionate, understanding and fair environment where you can really grow into the next phase of your career.” <em>VP WW Solution Architecture, Elastic</em></p> <h3><strong>What You Will Be Doing&nbsp;</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serving as the technical point of contact for your accounts and account managers in your assigned territory.</li> <li>Developing a deep understanding of customers’ goals and objectives, and articulating how our offerings address their needs.</li> <li>Creating and owning value based relationships at all levels in customer organizations.</li> <li>Actively participating in all phases of planning and execution for your territory, from initial discovery to the technical win.</li> <li>Developing and maintaining a deep understanding of the Elastic products and solutions to demonstrate the value of our offerings in sales meetings, and at events such as meetups and conferences.</li> <li>Advising the sales team on effective ways of positioning Elastic products, solutions and services.</li> <li>Onboarding, educating and enabling our partners, and supporting them in sales cycles.</li> <li>Creating collateral, contributing to programs and collaborating with other Elasticians to meet individual client needs.</li> <li>Being the voice of the customer and community to communicate needs, gaps, and enhancements to our engineering and leadership teams.</li> <li>Deepening both your sales and technical skills through self driven education while taking advantage of all the professional development opportunities provided by Elastic.</li> </ul&g

Along the way, you'll develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and work closely with our Services, Engineering and Sales teams.</p> <p>Elastic is a remote-first company, but many of the projects you'll deliver might require onsite availability, making the role hybrid in practice, varying by project, with travel of up to 60%.<br>Some of these engagements, given the organisations involved, also require national security screening or clearance; eligibility to obtain one in your country of employment is a strong advantage, and Elastic will sponsor the process where required.</p> <h2><strong>What You Will Be Doing</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Assess and Design</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Analyse customer goals, pain points, existing architecture, and threat landscape, translating them Deliver</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead hands-on delivery of Elastic Security projects end-to-end, including greenfield deployments and migrations from legacy SIEM/EDR platforms in mission-critical environments</li> <li>Deploy and secure the Elastic platform: cluster architecture, RBAC and role mapping, single sign-on, private connectivity (private links, VPC peering), and hardening for detection-as-code practices for customers managing detections programmatically: developing, testing, versioning, and deploying detection content with Python, Git, and CI/CD pipelines</li> <li>Apply and enable Elastic's Agentic AI capabilities (AI Assistant, Attack Discovery, agent-driven workflows) to accelerate customers' detection and response</li> </ul

With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the role: Backend engineering rarely gets this consequential. As a Software Engineer on Camunda's Core / API & Process Automation team, you'll work on the beating heart of Camunda 8 — the event-sourced, distributed workflow engine that executes business-critical processes for thousands of customers and, through them, millions of people worldwide. Because you sit at the core, one well-made improvement propagates outward through every integration and product built on top of it: a small change here is felt everywhere. Few systems demand this. You'll dig into the performance of the hot paths, into versioning strategies for an engine that must faithfully replay every event it has ever written — forever, and into the concurrency between the engine advancing a process and a user mutating that same process in the same instant. And the bar is unforgiving: data must never be corrupted, and a process must never get stuck — because when it does, customers lose money. This is genuine distributed-systems work — event sourcing, ordering, concurrency, replay — not another CRUD app. You'll also help build what comes next — including enabling AI agents to drive the engine, cutting-edge work that stretches what the industry thinks automation can do. You'll do it alongside a world-spanning team of highly skilled, highly motivated engineers who share one goal: make Camunda the best workflow engine in the world. And this is where you grow fast: you'll own well-scoped work end-to-end, deliberately take on unfamiliar and uncomfortable problems to stretch yourself, and learn from senior engineers you work beside every day — with everything shipping in the open (Zeebe is open source). Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale What You’ll Be Doing: Build and evolve features in the event-sourced engine and its C8 REST/gRPC/MCP API (command/event, CQRS), with guidance on the harder design calls. Own well-scoped work end-to-end — implement, test, and ship; contribute your ideas to solution designs and write clear design notes / ADRs. Help ship high-impact engine features — like suspending and resuming individual process instances, enabling AI agents to steer running processes, and variable tracing — and watch them reach thousands of customers. Design and consume clean APIs — good contracts, developer ergonomics, and an awareness of not breaking existing integrations. Detect and optimize inefficient processing and data-access patterns across our data stores (RocksDB, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, relational/Postgres) — growing into the harder cases — and build observability into what you ship. Du verantwortest die Produktvision, übersetzt Anforderungen in umsetzbare Lösungen und bringst Fachbereiche, IT, Stakeholder:innen und externe Partner:innen an einen Tisch. Projekte steuern & Umsetzung begleiten Du planst und koordinierst IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte und behältst Ziele, Termine, Qualität und Ressourcen im Blick. Du schaffst Transparenz über Fortschritt, Abhängigkeiten und offene Entscheidungen. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit den Projektbeteiligten dafür, dass aus Konzepten funktionierende Lösungen werden. Dabei bist du von Anfang bis Ende mitten im Geschehen und hast ein Team an deiner Seite , das fachlich top ist, menschlich der Knaller und jeden Partybus das Fürchten lehrt. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision. That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere. About the role This is a senior, hands-on product role for someone who wants to own a meaningful slice of the MUBI product end-to-end, and is at their best when the problem is still ambiguous. You’ll own the Audience & Platform Expansion domain - a critical product surface for our next phase of growth. In this role, you will be responsible for building the scalable foundation to drive global subscriber acquisition and pioneer our tiered premium offerings. You’ll own its strategy, its roadmap and its delivery, from a high-level business goal all the way to a shipped, measured feature. The hardest product problems at MUBI cross team and time-zone boundaries, and break down without someone holding the whole picture; this role exists to be that person for one of these domains. Reporting to our Senior Product Director, this is a senior, individual contributor role. You'll lead through clarity and influence rather than headcount - aligning engineering, design and data scientists around a vision they actually believe in, and mentoring/coaching other, more junior PMs as you go. Partner directly with Engineering, UX/UI Design, Data Science, Marketing, Business Development and Legal to define product requirements and resolve trade-offs. Establish the KPIs and OKRs for your area, and use data-backed insight to iterate quickly and demonstrate measurable impact. Pitch roadmaps to senior leadership to guide resource allocation, and align engineering, design and analytics teams without relying on direct hierarchy. jobs.title: Senior Software Entwickler / Tech Lead – Java, Spring & Jakarta EE*

jobs.description: About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️ Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in! We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates. With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️ Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation. Why RoomPriceGenie? We take both culture and product seriously: recognized as Best Place to Work in HotelTech (2026) and Best Revenue Management Software (2026) . We power pricing for thousands of hotels worldwide on a modern data stack. This is a fully remote role within Europe (UTC+0 to UTC+2) . You will have genuine ownership, strong support, and the opportunity to build high-value internal AI systems and agents that make our operational teams significantly faster and smarter. Your Role As an AI Systems & Automation Engineer , you will drive internal AI adoption across Customer Success, Sales, and Operations. Your job isn't to build raw ML models or write throwaway demos. You will work directly with business leads to unblock legacy processes, connect internal data to core operational tools, and deploy dependable, supervised AI agents that automate complex workflows. You will join our AI & Security team and bridge the gap between our core data platforms (Snowflake, Postgres, DocumentDB, S3) and our GTM stack (HubSpot, Chargebee, Modjo, Notion), establishing practical patterns for safe, agentic automation across the business. What You’ll Do Translate Business Pain into Systems: Partner directly with Customer Success, Sales, and Ops teams to map out manual, multi-step workflows and design high-ROI AI automation targets. Build Production Agents & Integrations: Write clean, maintainable code (Python/TypeScript) connecting LLM APIs to internal data stores and third-party SaaS platforms (HubSpot, Chargebee, Modjo, Notion). Implement Modern Agent Standards: Build modular agent capabilities using standardized tools and schemas (such as Agent Skills standards, Claude Plugins, or custom function-calling pipelines) to give models safe, structured action boundaries. Design Human-in-the-Loop Workflows: Implement strict guardrails, schema validation, human approval gates, and escalation paths so non-technical staff can safely supervise AI outputs. Ensure Integration Reliability: Manage API rate limits, Webhooks, asynchronous jobs, and retry logic to keep integrations rock-solid as internal data volume grows. Measure & Iterate: Build lightweight evaluation harnesses to track agent accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, and cost, optimizing prompt architectures and model choices based on real production usage. Your Profile Strong Software Fundamentals: Solid background in Python and/or TypeScript, asynchronous execution, REST APIs, Webhooks, SQL, and working with relational or analytical databases. Claude & LLM Ecosystem Expertise: Deep, hands-on proficiency with Claude (Anthropic API, Prompt Engineering, Workbench, SDKs) and adjacent modern developer applications. Agent Skill & Tool Design: Familiarity with modern agent capability frameworks, such as standard Agent Skills ( agentskills.io ), Claude Plugins / Model Context

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Backend - Core/API & Process Automation
jobs.description: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the role: Backend engineering rarely gets this consequential. As a Software Engineer on Camunda's Core / API & Process Automation team, you'll work on the beating heart of Camunda 8 — the event-sourced, distributed workflow engine that executes business-critical processes for thousands of customers and, through them, millions of people worldwide. Because you sit at the core, one well-made improvement propagates outward through every integration and product built on top of it: a small change here is felt everywhere. Few systems demand this. You'll dig into the performance of the hot paths, into versioning strategies for an engine that must faithfully replay every event it has ever written — forever, and into the concurrency between the engine advancing a process and a user mutating that same process in the same instant. And the bar is unforgiving: data must never be corrupted, and a process must never get stuck — because when it does, customers lose money. This is genuine distributed-systems work — event sourcing, ordering, concurrency, replay — not another CRUD app. You'll also help build what comes next — including enabling AI agents to drive the engine, cutting-edge work that stretches what the industry thinks automation can do. You'll do it alongside a world-spanning team of highly skilled, highly motivated engineers who share one goal: make Camunda the best workflow engine in the world. And this is where you grow fast: you'll own well-scoped work end-to-end, deliberately take on unfamiliar and uncomfortable problems to stretch yourself, and learn from senior engineers you work beside every day — with everything shipping in the open (Zeebe is open source). Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale What You’ll Be Doing: Build and evolve features in the event-sourced engine and its C8 REST/gRPC/MCP API (command/event, CQRS), with guidance on the harder design calls. Own well-scoped work end-to-end — implement, test, and ship; contribute your ideas to solution designs and write clear design notes / ADRs. Help ship high-impact engine features — like suspending and resuming individual process instances, enabling AI agents to steer running processes, and variable tracing — and watch them reach thousands of customers. Design and consume clean APIs — good contracts, developer ergonomics, and an awareness of not breaking existing integrations. Detect and optimize inefficient processing and data-access patterns across our data stores (RocksDB, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, relational/Postgres) — growing into the harder cases — and build observability into what you ship. Proactively

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (m/f/d) for telemedicine platform
jobs.description: Your role at Ocumeda As Staff Software Engineer (m/f/d) you are the engineer who makes hard, unclear or broken things tractable. You know how our platform works end to end and you shape it as you go. Your focus is our full-stack platform: the web application our doctors, our optician partners, and their customers use daily, and the services behind it. This is an individual contributor role. No direct reports, real technical authority: you set direction on architecture and engineering practice, and you build in the same codebase as everyone else in the team. Staff/Senior here means deeper, not further from the code. Your job is to keep our systems fast to iterate, reliable in production, and ready for international expansion and scaling. Own the architecture of our full-stack platform – frontend, backend, data, AWS – and evolve it under real product pressure instead of rewriting it Own our testing strategy: where we invest in unit, integration and end-to-end coverage, what we deliberately do not test, and how tests stay fast enough that nobody skips them Push our agentic coding practice forward: tooling, guardrails and testing discipline that make us faster without putting unverified code into a live product Shape scope together with product: surface the cheap 80 % solution, and say clearly when something is not worth building Build so that what ships is operable and auditable by design (e.g. ISO 27001, ISO 13485), without turning engineering into paperwork Go wherever the problem is – a scaling bottleneck one week, a broken integration the next – you fix it properly What makes you a great fit Several years of professional software engineering experience (roughly 7+), most of it on systems that reached real users Deeply hands-on across the stack: strong in the frontend, at home in the backend, comfortable in the infrastructure and web technologies around it A strong background in TypeScript, and well-formed opinions you can defend and revise A clear product focus: you care about what ships, what runs, and what users experience You speak fluent English (C1); German is a plus ... and as a nice to have: Experience in a start-up or scale-up where speed and quality both mattered Comfort taking ownership and shaping processes nobody has defined yet A degree in a STEM field – equivalent practical experience counts more Exposure to regulated software, medical devices or health data If you match most of this, apply. We would rather read your application than have you rule yourself out. What you can expect from us Flexible working hours and hybrid work with home office options Subsidized Deutschlandticket (public transport pass) for employees Personal learning & development budget for trainings, conferences, and professional growth High level of ownership, fast decision-making, and real opportunities to help shape the company Regular feedback, short decision paths, and individual development opportunities International team with close collaboration, regular exchange, and shared team events Collaboration with experts from optometry, ophthalmology, software & AI development, and strategy consulting Monthly contribution toward a Wellpass membership Free access to Nilo Health for mental health and wellbeing Competitive salary matching your role and experience Modern, dog-friendly office in the heart of Munich, close to the main train station (Hauptbahnhof) Contributing to a leading teleophthalmology platform that sustainably improves access to eye care Established B2B2C model with over 800 partner optician locations and more than 500,000 screenings performed Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Product Owner – SDV Data Products (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Intro Adsquare's mission is centered on: Passion: Solving complex challenges with exceptional people, technology, and data. Niche: Specializing in Location Intelligence for Programmatic Advertisers. Our work is guided by our core values, and we look for candidates who embody them: Drive: Turning ambition into action that brings valuable outcomes. Resilience: Adapting, persevering, and growing stronger through challenges. No BS: Upholding honesty, transparency, and clear communication. Humble: Valuing modesty and letting results speak for themselves. Moral Compass: Acting with fairness, integrity, and respect. About the team You'll join Adsquare's Data Products team, responsible for the pipelines and signals that power our Location Intelligence solutions. Working closely with our Lead PM for Data Products and a squad of data engineers, you'll help ingest, process, and scale the supplier and panel data that fuels our products. Your squad sits at the intersection of engineering, data governance, and downstream teams like Measurement and Activation, ensuring the signals we deliver are fast, reliable, and trustworthy. Your Mission As Product Owner for SDV Data Products (f/m/d), you'll own your squad's delivery, turning strategy into clear, testable backlog items while managing the technical scale of our core data pipelines. You'll be the primary technical counterpart to our data suppliers and panel partners, driving the operational reliability that keeps our signals fresh and trusted. Your Profile 3-5 years of experience as a Product Owner or technical PM, ideally in AdTech, MarTech, or another data-heavy ecosystem. Strong at managing delivery and technical scale: sequencing complex backend work, mapping dependencies, and scoping against time, whether working with engineers, architects, or integration teams. Operationally rigorous: comfortable thinking in SLIs, SLOs, freshness, match rate, and MTTR, not just features shipped, and skilled at running a tight, testable backlog. Data-fluent, with required SQL proficiency: able to independently query internal data sources to investigate supplier data, panel quality, and pipeline KPIs, and bring quantified evidence into prioritisation. Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make decisions with limited information and translate business intent clearly for engineering. A privacy-aware product thinker who understands data governance and how evolving privacy frameworks affect upstream ingestion and pipeline logic. A clear communicator across altitudes, able to translate strategy into specs and engineering reality into product trade-offs. A true owner who drives outcomes without step-by-step direction and surfaces tensions upward rather than resolving them quietly. What you will do Own and maintain your squad's backlog, working closely with the Lead PM for Data Products to translate strategy into clear, testable user stories. Lead the roadmap for modernising, scaling, and optimising our core data ingestion and processing pipelines to handle high-throughput workloads. Manage internal dependencies — SLAs, schema contracts, and joint roadmap touchpoints — with downstream squads such as Measurement, Activation, and Data Products. Coordinate releases of new schemas, ingestion endpoints, match logic changes, and signal product enhancements. Act as the primary PO-level counterpart to data supplier and panel partner technical teams, co-owning ingestion specs and schema contracts. Support the Lead PM on new supplier partnerships and panel expansion through feasibility input, integration scoping, and prototype delivery. Define, own, and report on operational KPIs such as signal freshness, SLA adherence, panel coverage, schema validation pass rate, and match rate. Establish SLIs, SLOs, and escalation paths in partnership with engineering, and own the operational visibility layer (dashboards, alerts) that surfaces data product health. jobs.title: Product Owner (all genders)
jobs.description: Deine Rolle bei uns Digitalisierung ist kein Buzzword, sondern eine Haltung. In deiner Rolle als Product Owner (all genders) gestaltest du digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen, die echten Nutzen schaffen – für Anwender:innen, Organisationen und anspruchsvolle Projekte. Du verantwortest die Produktvision, übersetzt Anforderungen in umsetzbare Lösungen und bringst Fachbereiche, IT, Stakeholder:innen und externe Partner:innen an einen Tisch. Dabei denkst du nicht nur agil oder klassisch – sondern situativ das, was wirklich funktioniert. Welche Aufgaben auf dich warten Digitale Lösungen gestalten & weiterentwickeln Du entwickelst Ideen und Zielbilder für digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen. Du strukturierst und priorisierst Anforderungen und übersetzt sie gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten in umsetzbare Lösungen. Du begleitest digitale Lösungen über verschiedene Phasen hinweg – von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung. Projekte steuern & Umsetzung begleiten Du planst und koordinierst IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte und behältst Ziele, Termine, Qualität und Ressourcen im Blick. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>THE ROLE</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Senior Category Manager, Men’s EU</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a <strong>Senior Category Manager, Men’s EU&nbsp;</strong>to join our growing team reporting into the Head of Merchandising, Men’s UK. jobs.title: Lead Pricing & Revenue Manager
jobs.description: Why loveholidays? At loveholidays - we trailblaze together . We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away. We’re using progressive tech to drive cutting-edge innovation and open the world to everyone. Within our Commercial and Support teams , you'll find a place to accelerate your growth by actively seeking learning opportunities and carving your own path. You'll create impact for our future by owning projects and shaping the business strategy to reach shared goals, all within our enhanced international community of collaborative and passionate teams. About the team The Revenue Management team is responsible for maximising final margin and driving sustainable growth by strategically managing key commercial levers, including pricing, payment plans, and cancellation terms. The impact you’ll have Reporting to the Head of Pricing and Revenue Management, you will lead the Revenue Management Centre of Excellence. You will shape the strategy, policies and capabilities that enable confident pricing, payment-plan and cancellation-term decisions across the business. Working with Platform and commercial teams, you will set the principles, guardrails and ways of working that support scalable, long-term commercial performance. Your day-to-day: Shape cross-market Revenue Management strategy, setting clear commercial principles, policies and decision guardrails. Use market and operational insight to identify structural opportunities to strengthen our pricing power and long-term commercial performance Lead cross-functional strategic initiatives and experiments with commercial and Platform teams from concept to delivery, navigating trade-offs. Identify high-value AI use cases and apply AI tools to improve the Revenue Management team’s efficiency, capacity and quality of output. Partner with Platform to shape the roadmap for new Revenue Management and AI capabilities, translating commercial needs into scalable systems and tools. Develop and embed consistent methods, playbooks and operating rhythms that strengthen the Revenue Management function. Act as a trusted commercial sounding board, bringing Revenue Management insight to decisions and initiatives across the business. Your skillset: Significant experience in Revenue Management, pricing strategy or a comparable commercial role, shaping direction across markets, products or customer segments. Excellent commercial judgement, able to navigate ambiguity, challenge assumptions and make well-reasoned trade-offs that support long-term value and growth. Advanced analytical and experimentation skills, able to set robust measurement approaches and use evidence to inform strategic choices. Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional programmes, building alignment with commercial and platform stakeholders around shared outcomes. Strong technical and product awareness, able to translate commercial needs into scalable capability roadmaps and identify high-value applications of AI and automation. Credible, influential communication skills, able to turn complex analysis into clear, compelling narratives for senior stakeholders and cross-functional audiences Desirable: Travel-sector or marketplace experience Experience using AI tools to increase team effectiveness and improve commercial decision-making. Experience with SQL, Looker or comparable analytical tools. This customer ships localized content across dozens of titles, platforms and languages, and the program spans in-game text, marketing and UA content, cinematics and trailers, and supporting print and digital collateral. Coordinate subtitling, voiceover (AI and human) and video localization for trailers, cinematics and other video assets, including timing, rendering, editing and final QC of localized video files. Oversee desktop publishing (DTP) workflows for localized packaging, manuals and marketing collateral, working with DTP specialists to maintain layout fidelity across languages. Run thorough linguistic and mechanical/functional QC on every project, tracking issues to resolution and feeding recurring themes back into style guides, glossaries and linguist onboarding. Use LILT-proprietary AI localization tools and build/maintain customer-specific translation memories and termbases to maintain consistency and leverage across projects. Support vendor management, including onboarding and evaluating linguists and other specialist vendors for the account. Support other project managers on the account, sharing best practice on production workflows and quality standards. What You'll Bring Proven experience as a project manager in the localization industry, with direct experience delivering programs for a game publisher or games customer. The first datacentres are going live and more sites are in build. Granite is hiring a Marketing Manager to build the path from a campaign to a sales conversation: the marketing operating rhythm, the lead generation engine, and the CRM discipline that turns interest into qualified pipeline. jobs.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're looking for a Data Scientist to take ownership of the datasets and evaluation workflows that underpin our AI Safety work. You'll turn real-world product data into reliable, well-structured datasets for training and evaluating models, and help build the processes and infrastructure to continuously assess how those models perform in production. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of data science, ML, AI safety, and policy. You'll work closely with safety researchers, engineers, and policy specialists to translate complex safety requirements into practical data and evaluation systems - starting hands-on with collection, analysis, and labelling, then building the methodologies, contributor networks, and quality standards that let this work scale. In this role, you will Own safety datasets end-to-end: collection, cleaning, labelling, quality control, versioning, and readiness for training and evaluation. Translate safety policy into clear, consistent labelling and evaluation criteria, working closely with policy specialists. Design and manage labelling processes, including sourcing, onboarding, and overseeing external contributors to a high quality bar. Build evaluation workflows for models in production, using real-world data to track performance and surface issues. jobs.description: About Hiya At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective. Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve. Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes. This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed. About the Role Hiya is growing its SMB customer base across the UK and Europe, and this role exists to retain and grow that business. jobs.title: Applied AI Architect, Education
jobs.description: About the Team The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams. Within Education, we partner with universities, schools, research institutions, and countrywide education systems to advance responsible, mission-aligned uses of AI. These environments require more than technical deployment: success depends on institutional trust, thoughtful governance, stakeholder education, change management, and a value narrative that resonates with academic leaders, researchers, IT teams, faculty, administrators, and students. This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance. About the Role As an Applied AI Architect for Education, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of education customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business,” shaping each institution’s AI strategy and guiding its journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable institutional impact. You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Edu, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate institutional priorities into a focused portfolio of use cases, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable value and growth. The Account Director owns the commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value. You will work across academic, research, administrative, and operational contexts—helping customers determine where AI can responsibly improve teaching and learning, accelerate research, strengthen student and faculty services, and make institutional operations more effective. You will account for the realities of education environments, including shared governance, complex stakeholder networks, academic calendars, accessibility, data privacy, responsible-AI expectations, and the need to build confidence among communities with differing levels of AI readiness. You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, education programs, and partners. This role calls for strong education-sector fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy, academic and operational workflows, and hands-on technical conversations. In this role, you will: Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing education customers and pre-sales prospects. Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, value-realization path, and expansion opportunities. Lead discovery with institutional executives, academic leaders, researchers, faculty, administrators, and technical teams to identify and prioritize use cases connected to meaningful institutional objectives. Translate education priorities into clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, institutional data, identity, integrations, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment. Guide institutions through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, building confidence in both the solution and its responsible path to production. As AI becomes increasingly important to how organizations operate, the ability to translate sophisticated products and commercial structures into clear, compelling customer narratives is a strategic advantage. This is a builder role that will begin as a high-impact individual contributor. The successful candidate will establish the EMEA Deal Strategy motion hands-on with the potential over time to build and lead a broader regional team. In this role, you will serve as the EMEA Deal Strategy leader and an embedded strategic partner to account teams, with a particular focus on high-value, complex, and first-of-kind deals. You will work directly with sellers and cross-functional partners to personally lead the overall deal strategy, structuring, value narrative, negotiations, and business cases that bring business terms to contractual closure. You will also translate insights and patterns from individual deals into a regional operating model, practical frameworks, tools, and resources that improve the quality, consistency, and scalability of deal execution across the field. jobs.description: The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify’s subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly. Spotify's Customer Service Platform powers interactions between our users and support teams. As a Product Manager, you will shape the tools, channels, and foundational APIs that enable our advisors to deliver fast, effective, and empathetic support at scale. You’ll help improve the advisor experience through intelligent tooling, define how customers reach support across channels, and strengthen the API layer underpinning our service ecosystem. Your work will bring platform thinking together with real human impact, helping our advisors do their best work and improving how users experience Spotify support.   What You'll Do Own the product vision and roadmap for the tools our support advisors use every day, improving efficiency and enabling better outcomes for users. Define and evolve how customers access support across chat, email, social messaging, and emerging channels, helping the right contact reach the right advisor at the right time. Strengthen the foundational API layer connecting our support systems, with a focus on reliability, extensibility, and developer experience as the platform scales. Take initiatives from discovery through launch, partnering closely with engineering to ship iteratively, learn quickly, and deliver meaningful outcomes. Identify opportunities to thoughtfully apply AI and automation within advisor workflows and channel routing to improve speed, accuracy, and the advisor experience. Collaborate with engineering, design, data science, and customer service operations to build scalable capabilities that serve both advisors and users. Define meaningful success metrics, run experiments, and use data and customer insights to make clear prioritisation decisions and measure impact. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
jobs.description: A World-Changing Company   Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role   Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open ended question like “Why are we delaying so many flights?” or “How can we better identify instances of money laundering?” As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions. As an FDSE, your responsibilities look similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team. Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. You’ll work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop. Core Responsibilities Impact: We take on meaningful and challenging projects that change the world for the better. Ownership: We see projects through from beginning to end, working through any obstacles we may encounter. Collaboration: We work internally with people from a variety of backgrounds — such as other FDSEs, product teams, and Deployment Strategists. We also work externally with our customers, often on site, to understand and solve their problems. Trust: We trust each other to effectively manage time and priorities and give people the space to think for themselves. Growth: We encourage ourselves and our peers to seek new challenges and opportunities for growth, as well as find new ways to innovate and share knowledge. Learning: We often face entirely novel problems where we need to pick up a lot of new knowledge and learn how to use it to make progress. We believe experiential learning is one of the best teachers. What We Value Strong engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science. A highly analytical mindset and eagerness to solve technical problems with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools. Experience or interest in working with and using large scale data to solve valuable business problems. Strong coder with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar. Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in teams of technical and non-technical individuals, and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment with dynamic objectives and iteration with users. Ability to continuously learn, work independently, and make decisions with minimal supervision. Willingness and interest to travel as needed to client sites. Ability to travel 25-50% preferred, but may vary by team and location. jobs.title: Systemadministrator Linux (m/w/d)
jobs.description: **Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll?**🚀 Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz. Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source . In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. Aufgaben Als Systemadministrator Linux hältst du nicht nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen, sondern entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die zukünftige IT-Landschaft des Unternehmens. Linux & Infrastruktur: Verantworte und optimiere die Linux Systemlandschaft sowie die zugehörige Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur. Open Source: Entwickle bestehende Systeme konsequent weiter und begleite Migrationen von Standardsoftware zu geeigneten Open Source Alternativen. Virtualisierung & Automatisierung: Arbeite mit Technologien wie Proxmox, Docker und vSphere und automatisiere Prozesse beispielsweise mit Python und Ansible. Cyber Security: Entwickle Security und Resilience weiter und beschäftige dich mit technischen Anforderungen rund um NIS 2, DSGVO, CRA und TISAX. KI Infrastruktur: Betreue und erweitere den unternehmenseigenen Linux basierten KI-Server und schaffe eine sichere Infrastruktur für die interne Nutzung künstlicher Intelligenz. Technischer Support: Löse komplexere interne IT-Fragestellungen für überwiegend technisch versierte Anwender mit Schwerpunkt auf dem zweiten und dritten Supportlevel. Qualifikation Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker , IT-Systemadministrator, abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Linux Administration nach Abschluss deiner Ausbildung oder deines Studiums. Sehr gute Linux Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest bereits routiniert mit Linux und möchtest dich nicht erst in das Betriebssystem einarbeiten. Solides Verständnis von Netzwerktechnik, Netzwerkprotokollen und IT-Infrastruktur . Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung oder Containertechnologien wie Proxmox, Docker oder vSphere. Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung , beispielsweise mit Python, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Technologien. Begeisterung für Open Source und Interesse daran, eine IT-Landschaft langfristig auf offenen und sicheren Lösungen aufzubauen. Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1 Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Eigenständige, pragmatische Arbeitsweise und Lust darauf, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam im Team neue Lösungen auszuprobieren. Kenntnisse in Nextcloud, Open Xchange, Nginx, pfSense, OpenVPN, Git oder Ceph sowie Erfahrung mit IT Security sind von Vorteil. Benefits Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung weiterentwickelt. Spannende Zukunftsprojekte: Arbeite unter anderem an Open Source Migrationen, dem Ausbau der IT Security und einem eigenen internen Linux basierten KI Server. Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite en
